name: Blushing
overview: The Bible presents blushing as a natural response connected to shame and recognition of sin, as seen in Ezra 9:6 where the prophet expresses deep shame and reluctance to face God because of the people's increased guilt. In contrast, Jeremiah 6:15 and 8:12 highlight a hardened heart that neither feels shame nor blushes despite committing abominations, resulting in judgment and downfall. These verses reveal that blushing with shame reflects a repentant spirit, while the absence of shame signals spiritual pride and impending divine discipline.
